serve
Serve a versioned HTTP and WebSocket API for one save.

Usage: hoshi serve [--save PATH] [--bind ADDRESS:PORT] [--config DIR]

Wraps one locked local save. Loopback binding is the default; authenticated remote actions use the same core rules. No automatic update request is made.

Example:
  hoshi serve --save game.sqlite

Environment: HOSHI_SAVE, HOSHI_BALANCE, HOSHI_SERVE_TOKEN, HOSHI_SERVE_TOKEN_FILE, HOSHI_SERVE_PUSH, HOSHI_SERVE_PUSH_ENDPOINT, HOSHI_SERVE_VAPID_PRIVATE, HOSHI_SERVE_VAPID_SUBJECT, HOSHI_SERVE_OIDC, HOSHI_SERVE_OIDC_ISSUER, HOSHI_SERVE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID, HOSHI_SERVE_OIDC_AUTHORIZATION, HOSHI_SERVE_OIDC_TOKEN
Exit codes: 0 success; 2 invalid input; 3 action refused; 4 save locked; 5 internal or save error.
